description: This file defines the SugarFieldMultienum class, a subclass of SugarFieldEnum, which handles multi-enumeration custom fields in SuiteCRM. It includes methods for setup, display rendering, saving, and importing sanitization specific to multienum fields.

classes.name: SugarFieldMultienum
classes.description: A custom field type for handling multi-select enumeration fields, extending SugarFieldEnum with additional logic specific to multienum operations.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Configures the field, resolving options list and setting workflow display parameters.

methods.name: getSearchViewSmarty
methods.description: Returns the search view rendering, using different templates based on function return type.

methods.name: displayFromFunc
methods.description: Displays the field value based on a display type, delegating to specific Smarty methods.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the multienum field value to the bean, handling multiselect logic.

methods.name: importSanitize
methods.description: Sanitizes input data for import, validating and encoding multienum values.
